title: BTS Confirmed for 52nd American Music Awards — First Award Show Appearance in Four Years, Live in Las Vegas May 25
detail: BTS is confirmed to make a special appearance at the 52nd American Music Awards on May 21, 2026, marking the group's first award show performance in approximately four years. The ceremony airs live on May 25, 2026 on CBS and Paramount+ from the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas — conveniently co-located with the ARIRANG World Tour's Las Vegas engagement. The show is hosted by Queen Latifah. BTS is nominated for three categories: Artist of the Year, Song of the Summer ('SWIM'), and Best K-Pop Artist. The AMA confirmation comes days after BTS completes their three-night Stanford Stadium Bay Area residency and just days before their four Allegiant Stadium Las Vegas shows (May 23, 24, 27, 28). KPopStarz (May 21) and Billboard both report the appearance as a 'special' AMA moment — whether performance, award acceptance, or both has not been officially specified ahead of the broadcast. The appearance would mark BTS's return to a major US televised award ceremony stage, having last appeared at US award shows in 2022.

title: Las Vegas Monorail BTS ARIRANG Wrap Launches — All Seven Stations Branded Through June 4
detail: The Las Vegas Monorail BTS-themed activation officially launches on May 21, 2026, covering all seven stations along the 3.9-mile route through June 4, 2026. The activation — part of 'BTS: The City Arirang' citywide festival — includes full exterior vinyl wraps on Monorail trains and BTS ARIRANG-branded station signage, creating a continuous K-pop themed transit experience connecting MGM Grand, Bally's/Paris, Flamingo/Caesars Palace, Harrah's/The LINQ, Las Vegas Convention Center, Westgate, and the SLS Las Vegas stations. Las Vegas Weekly publishes a feature piece on May 21 headlined 'BTS is back: Exploring K-pop's ascension and fandom in Las Vegas,' documenting the ARMY community that has converged on the city from around the world ahead of the Allegiant Stadium shows. The monorail branding is described by ARMY social media as a 'full city takeover.' With the monorail activation, all major elements of 'BTS: The City Arirang' Las Vegas are now live: Arte Museum (opened May 20), Forum Shops Pop-Up (opened May 20), citywide red illumination (opened May 20), and Monorail wraps (opened May 21). The Las Vegas Sphere Exosphere ARIRANG visuals launch tomorrow, May 22, running through May 28.
